stem: A dashboard used by hundreds of concurrent viewers must load instantly and only needs to reflect data as of last night's scheduled refresh, not the current moment.

choices.text: Import the dataset into Amazon QuickSight and cache it in SPICE
Configure the QuickSight dataset to query the source directly on every load
Run the same Athena query again for every dashboard view instead of caching it
Publish a Glue for Ray job that emails a static report nightly

rationale: Importing the dataset into QuickSight's SPICE in-memory engine avoids re-querying the source on every interaction, giving hundreds of concurrent viewers a fast, cached dashboard that matches the nightly-refresh freshness the requirement accepts. Querying the source directly on every load re-runs the query for every viewer, trading away the fast, cached performance the scenario wants for freshness the scenario does not need. Re-running the same Athena query for every view has the same repeated-query cost and no dashboard layer for viewers to interact with. A Glue for Ray job that emails a static report is a scheduled report, not an interactive dashboard hundreds of people can load and explore.
